ex.t: The tone of the text is critical.
The writer implies the government is lying.
The omission of key facts creates bias.
His words carry an undertone of blame.
Check the provenance of the source.

title.ko: 비판적 읽기: bias · tone · loaded language · imply · infer · omission
title.en: critical reading: bias, tone, loaded language, imply, infer, omission

explain.ko: 비판적 읽기는 글이 무엇을 말하는지뿐 아니라 어떻게, 왜 말하는지를 살핍니다. 편향(bias), 어조(tone), 감정적 어휘(loaded language), 선택적 인용과 누락(omission)을 분석하면 필자가 직접 말하지 않은 함축(implication)을 추론(infer)할 수 있습니다. 필자는 암시(imply)하고 독자는 추론(infer)한다는 점에 유의하세요. 출처(provenance)와 목적을 확인하고 여러 자료를 비교하는 것이 기본입니다.
explain.en: Critical reading examines not only what a text says but how and why it says it. By analysing bias, tone, loaded language, selective quotation and omission, you can infer implications the writer did not state. Note that writers imply while readers infer. Checking provenance and purpose and comparing several sources is the basic practice.

notes.en: Check the source and purpose first.

items.passage:
MEDIA LITERACY
Reading the news critically
News may not be perfectly objective. The same event gives different impressions depending on which words are used and what is left out. Check the source and purpose, and compare several outlets.

prompt.en: Write four sentences analysing the bias, tone and omissions of an imaginary article.

task.model: The article introduces only one side and so reveals bias. It uses loaded language to steer the reader. By omitting key statistics, it distorts the impression. A critical reader should first check the source.

model_trans.ko: 그 기사는 한쪽 입장만 소개해 편향을 드러내요. 감정적 어휘를 써서 독자를 유도해요. 중요한 통계를 누락해서 인상이 왜곡돼요. 비판적 독자는 출처를 먼저 확인해야 해요.
model_trans.en: The article introduces only one side and so reveals bias. It uses loaded language to steer the reader. By omitting key statistics, it distorts the impression. A critical reader should first check the source.
